newsitem.title: USA: U.S. first-quarter growth revised up slightly.
newsitem.headline: U.S. first-quarter growth revised up slightly.

text.p: Stronger foreign trade pushed the economy ahead at an even faster clip than previously thought in the first quarter this year, the Commerce Department said on Friday.

The department revised its estimate of growth in gross domestic product up fractionally to a booming 5.9 percent annual rate in the three months from January through March from the 5.8 percent rate it published a month ago.

It was the most robust economic performance in more than nine years, since GDP expanded at a 6 percent rate in the final three months of 1987 and far exceeded the 3.8 percent rate of expansion recorded in last year's final quarter.
